everyday_relevance.description: 1 to 5. Would a typical college student or young adult who does not invest notice this or be affected by it? 5 = national headline, or it changes their money, jobs and internships, student loans, rent and prices, gas, travel and airfares, phones and subscriptions, apps and brands they use, or taxes on a first job; 3 = a well-known company or a change some people will notice; 1 = institutional or routine paperwork (board seats, pay plans, small-bank enforcement, technical rules).
